faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHS Kanniyakumari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications for the DHS Kanniyakumari Recruitment 2026 is 24th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned office by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in DHS Kanniyakumari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Microbiologist, Lab Technician -Gr III, and Lab Assistant. These are contract-based positions within the District Health Society Kanniyakumari.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Lab Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Lab Assistant post is 8th pass. This makes the position accessible to a wider range of candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for a Microbiologist in DHS Kanniyakumari?
faq.answer: The salary for a Microbiologist is ₹. 44,000 per month, plus applicable taxes (GST 18%) and EPF contributions.

faq.question: Q5. How will the selection be done for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves recruitment through outsourcing agencies, and biometric attendance will be required for all selected candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for any of the posts in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply through online mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to submit their applications in a sealed cover either in person or by post.

faq.question: Q8. Where should I submit the application form?
faq.answer: The application form should be submitted in a sealed cover to the District Health Officer, District Health Office, Nagercoil - 1.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for all the advertised posts (Microbiologist, Lab Technician, Lab Assistant) is contract-based employment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for DHS Kanniyakumari?
faq.answer: The official website for District Health Society Kanniyakumari is Kanniyakumari.nic.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and to download the application form.
